subject: general
question: Which region in India is the least populated due to physical barriers and limited accessibility?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Northern Himalayas (Ladakh region)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Northern Himalayas, including the Ladakh region**, is one of the least populated regions in India due to its **extreme climatic conditions**, with temperatures often falling below freezing for most of the year.
 
• The region is characterized by **rugged terrain**, high-altitude deserts, and **limited arable land**, which makes agriculture and settlement challenging.
 
• Accessibility to the Ladakh region is severely restricted due to its **remote location** and **poor infrastructure**, with roads often blocked during winter months.
 
• Despite its scenic beauty and cultural significance, the **lack of basic amenities** such as water, healthcare, and education deters large-scale habitation.
 
• According to the **2011 Census of India**, the population density of Ladakh is among the lowest in the country, with fewer than 5 people per square kilometer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Challenges of Ladakh:**

 
 
• Ladakh lies at an altitude of over 3,000 meters, resulting in **low oxygen levels and harsh living conditions**.
 
• It is part of a cold desert ecosystem with **minimal precipitation**, further limiting agricultural activities.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• Ladakh holds strategic importance for India due to its proximity to international borders with **China and Pakistan**.
 
• The region is also home to important military installations to safeguard national security.
 
 
 
• **Tourism in Ladakh:**
 
 
• Ladakh is a popular tourist destination, known for attractions such as **Pangong Lake, Nubra Valley, and Leh Palace**.
 
• Tourism has become a significant source of income for the local population, but it is seasonal and dependent on accessibility.
 
 
 
• **Efforts for Development:**
 
 
• The government is investing in **infrastructure projects**, such as the Zojila Tunnel, to improve connectivity.
 
• Various schemes are being introduced to enhance the **livelihood of local communities** and promote sustainable development in the region.
